numerical.scope: Cumulative conditional ablations at identical existing integer weights, quantized X/P. Effects depend on ordering; not independent causal totals. Dot floor once after each matrix dot, never per multiplication. Approximate p-y gradient kept. No new training trajectory or materials. Integer protocol unchanged.
numerical.weight_rejection: src/operators.py train_step final e.check_range(nextw, operand(weight,12)); also XW0/HW1 and dH operand checks. Weight interval [-16384,16384) at f12 ([-4,4)). Current guard rejection is protocol applicability, not evidence of integer overflow; actual products/partials reported separately.
